name: Jiangsu Yawei Machine Tool Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Yawei Machine Tool Co., Ltd. engages in the sale of forming machine tools, laser processing equipment, and intelligent manufacturing solutions in China and internationally. It offers sheet metal machines, such as sheet metal laser cutting machine, tube laser cutting machine, and sheet metal laser automation equipment, as well as CNC press brake, panel bender, and turret punch; stamping machines, including servo and mechanical presses, fully automatic stamping line, blanking line, slitting line, cut-to-length line and with oscillation shear, and multi-stations progressive die production line.
